A new project card is allowed only as a copy of an existing card SVG with the same size, colours, fonts and animation, changing its text. Change content only, so the profile is current about Kone Tshivhinda, K-ONE IT SOLUTIONS and his GitHub: the latest projects and their status (AgentOS Studio, konethegreat/agentos-studio, at its latest GitHub release, never a fixed version), stack and links. Use only facts that can be checked: gh repo list konethegreat, each repository's README and GitHub releases, and the live sites; never claim a feature, client, number or result those sources do not show. Every link and image path must resolve. Credit stays with Kone Tshivhinda and K-ONE IT SOLUTIONS.
